# DakJen Creative LLC

> A boutique brand strategy and creative studio based in New York City and Baltimore. Founded by Dakotah Jennifer (CEO). Most creative studios see the brand; DakJen Creative sees the business it sits inside — five-plus years of operations, finance, and marketing experience inside a working real estate development business. Services, in order of focus: fractional creative and business leadership, RFP pipeline management, Notable brand platforms for founders, and lease-up marketing for affordable housing developers.

## Company Overview

DakJen Creative LLC is a boutique brand strategy and creative studio serving founders, executives, and mission-driven organizations. The differentiator is a whole-business view: the team has worked inside a real estate development business across operations, finance, and marketing, so engagements cover how a business actually runs, not just how it looks. Creative quality is the primary differentiator; the studio stays small so the founder leads every engagement personally.

- **Founder:** Dakotah Jennifer, CEO
- **Ownership:** Black-owned, woman-owned business
- **Certifications & registrations:** MDOT-certified MBE and SBE (Maryland) · SAM.gov registered (UEI DEN5Y8TUCTJ1) · WOSB/EDWOSB self-certified · WBENC in progress · SBA 8(a) eligible August 2026
- **Certified NAICS codes:** 541430 (graphic design), 541511 (custom web page design), 541611 (management consulting), 541613 (marketing consulting), 561599 (travel arrangement), 711510 (independent writers)
- **Locations:** New York, NY · Baltimore, MD
- **Service Areas (Lease-Up Marketing):** Based in D.C. metro & Baltimore, serving developers nationwide
- **Contact:** business@dakjencreative.com
- **Website:** https://dakjencreative.com

## Services

### Fractional Creative & Business Leadership
Our flagship service. Senior leadership embedded inside the business — brand and creative direction plus the business management around it (planning, process, budgets, vendor and team coordination). A dedicated brand department for founders and executives — without the full-time hire. Core focus: social media management, content strategy, brand positioning, campaign oversight, collateral production, and quarterly brand audits. Entry point: Brand Audit.

Retained creative tiers (embed a creative leader inside your business):
- Fractional Brand Manager — starting at $2,000/mo (brand guide, template suite, monthly check-in, creative review)
- Fractional Marketing Director — starting at $4,000/mo (adds bi-weekly strategy, campaign & content direction)
- Fractional Chief Creative Officer — starting at $7,000/mo (weekly access, creative architecture of new business lines)

The CMO Subscription (productized content & collateral retainer from DJC Marketing — done-for-you production on a flat monthly rate):
- Marketing Support — $1,500/mo · 3 requests per month · up to 10 pages of collateral · 36-business-hour turnaround · collateral + light strategy
- Marketing Manager — $3,500/mo · 5 requests per month · up to 25 pages of collateral · collateral + active strategy · standing check-in
- The CMO Subscription — custom quote · 10+ requests per month · page volume scoped to engagement · full marketing leadership · dedicated creative pod · paid ad management included
- Requests and pages are a monthly allowance (whichever cap is reached first); unused requests and pages roll over one month. Add-ons: website builds, photo & video, media buying. Pause anytime; annual option (pay 10 months, get 12 on the first two tiers).

- Clients include: Northern Real Estate Urban Ventures (NREUV), Project Community Capital (PCC)
- Page: https://dakjencreative.com/fractional.html

### RFP Pipeline (Government & Institutional Contracting)
Monthly RFP pipeline management for diverse-owned firms. DakJen Creative monitors the procurement portals, flags the opportunities that fit a firm's certifications and NAICS codes, and delivers a finished Draft 1 plus a requirements/compliance checklist. The client reviews, finalizes, and submits — DJC does not submit on a client's behalf.

Tiers:
- Monitor — $750/mo · portal monitoring across your NAICS codes and target agencies, weekly fit-scored digest, bid/no-bid recommendation
- Monitor + Draft — $1,500/mo · everything above, plus one full Draft 1 per month and a requirements/compliance checklist
- Pipeline Partner — $2,500/mo · everything above, plus multiple drafts, capability statement maintenance, and a monthly strategy call

Entry point: a free Opportunity Scan — two live matching solicitations emailed within 48 hours. Deliberately limited: the scan is a sample of the work, not a substitute for the service.

Sectors pursued: community development, education, housing, economic development, arts, nonprofits, and public interest work.
Sectors not pursued: defense or military, tobacco, healthcare or pharma, gambling, firearms, fossil fuel extraction. Cannabis work is limited to public health, education, and harm reduction.

- Page: https://dakjencreative.com/rfp.html

**Quote requests:** https://dakjencreative.com/quote.html — a form that takes the prospect's pain points, timeline, and budget and routes them to Dakotah directly. Response within two business days with a scoped quote or clarifying questions. No call required.

### Notable — Brand Platform for Women Founders
A tiered brand strategy platform built specifically for women founders. Offers visibility, positioning, and growth support at every stage. Includes access to the Vanguard Band community.
- Page: https://dakjencreative.com/notable.html

### Lease-Up Marketing (DJC Marketing)
Full-cycle lease-up marketing for affordable housing developments — from pre-leasing through stabilization. Based in the D.C. metro and Baltimore, serving developers nationwide. DJC Marketing understands how affordable housing is financed, how income-qualification works, and what it takes to reach applicants by design, not by volume.

Services include:
- Pre-leasing strategy and campaign planning
- Apartment listings (Apartments.com, Zillow, AffordableHousing.com, Craigslist)
- Paid social ads (Facebook, Instagram) and Google Display campaigns
- Organic social media content
- Traditional media: billboards, radio spots, newspaper ads, construction-site banners
- Community outreach: partnerships with churches, workforce agencies, social services
- Applicant communication and inquiry management
- Bi-weekly performance reports and stakeholder-ready summaries
- Model unit staging and professional photography
- Application support (re-review of rejected applications)

Pricing: campaigns start at $20,000 per engagement, all in (media spend, production, and vendor costs included).

Case study — 9410 Hough, Cleveland OH: 116-unit affordable housing development. 400+ inquiries in 48 hours. 36.2% applicant qualification rate (vs. 15–30% industry avg). >20% re-apply rate from application support.

- Page: https://dakjencreative.com/leaseup.html
- DJC Marketing site: https://marketing.dakjencreative.com

## Proven Results

### Brand Management & Platform Growth (5-Year Engagement)
- 237% LinkedIn network growth — 1,645 connections to 5,543
- 3,898 new connections added; 60%+ at Director level or above
- 28× comment engagement surge — avg. 26/yr before engagement → 731 in a single year
- 2,346 total comments during engagement vs. 215 in all prior years combined
- 336 posts published vs. 33 in all prior years combined — 10× increase
- 199 strategic company follows built from zero (JPMorgan, Goldman Sachs, Wells Fargo, CBRE)
- 6,557 total website visitors to the 8-page thought leader site built and maintained
- 500+ unique monthly visitors sustained after engagement close
- Platform enabled major earned media: Black Enterprise, Bisnow Innovator of the Year, Inc. 5000 (659% 3-year revenue growth), Crain's, Bloomberg Radio, Baltimore Business Journal Top 100 Women

### Lease-Up Marketing (9410 Hough, Cleveland OH — 116 units)
- 400+ qualified inquiries in the first 48 hours of launch
- 36.2% applicant qualification rate vs. 15–30% industry average
- +13.7 percentage points above industry benchmark
- >20% re-apply rate from application support program
